newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain subdued on dollar and Chicago.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain subdued on dollar and Chicago.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained untraded this afternoon on a very strong dollar and calls for a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening, market sources said.

"There were no trades reported as the strong dollar and a weaker CBOT project A kept buyers sidelined. Calls for a lower Chicago soycomplex futures opening this afternoon also kept a firm lid on activity," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
